opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland (or have a substantial recent connection to Scotland), are ineligible for government tuition fee support, and are enrolled on (or have an unconditional offer for) an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution. Must be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, hold Limited Leave to Remain valid for the course, or be an asylum seeker. Second-degree applicants considered only in limited skills-shortage subject areas.
opportunities.summary: Funding for individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for government tuition fee support to study for a first undergraduate degree (or a second degree in limited subject areas) at an eligible Scottish higher education institution. Covers tuition fees up to £1,820 per year.
discipline_tags: All subjects (first degree); limited skills-shortage subjects for second degrees (medicine & health, social work, IT & computing, engineering & architecture, quantitative sciences, geosciences, biosciences, cultural & creative studies)
